_: Phosphor glyph -> designmd sprite id. Built 2026-11-08 by looking at every candidate rendered at 26px with the kit's own fill:none, not by name similarity.

arrows-clockwise: circular refresh; the recurrence chip and the workstream row both mean 'repeats'
arrows-down-up: it is a select trigger (Select participants), not a sort — same glyph as caret-up-down
arrows-left-right: the OAuth brand pair; i-transfer is the horizontal double arrow, i-bidirectional is a circled vertical one
book-open: i-brochure IS an open book. Name reads like marketing, the glyph does not
briefcase: the literal briefcase. The chip says Busy, but the designer picked a briefcase and the pack has one
caret-left: there is no i-caret-left; i-chevron-left is the same chevron rotated 180
caret-up-down: the stacked up/down pair the kit already uses on selects
chat-circle-text: i-chat is the bubble with lines; i-chat-circle (plain bubble) is taken by ph-chat-circle
circle-notch: the spinner. Carries animation:spin in the page, so it needs a glyph that reads while rotating
file-text: a page with ruled lines — an exact shape match
flag-checkered: a checkered flag with a tick. Both the shape AND the role (roadmap target date) match
hash: the # is a Slack channel button (aria-label=Slack channel). The pack has no #, and the Slack mark says the same thing
list-magnifying-glass: the empty-agenda state. Keeps the designer's magnifier; i-tasks would have dropped it
monitor-play: the Meeting deck jump-link; same deck glyph as ph-presentation
note-pencil: it labels the notes FIELD, not an edit button. i-pencil is already ph-pencil-simple's target and would read as an edit affordance
plus-circle: the pack has no plus-in-circle. i-new is a compose pencil, not a plus
presentation: a board with content on it — the only glyph in the pack that depicts a presentation. Used for the Google Slides agenda card and the Slides OAuth scope
presentation-chart: the meeting-deck orb; same deck glyph
prohibit: the action is 'Remove from this agenda'. The pack has no no-entry sign; the circled X carries the same cancel meaning
skip-forward: an arrow stepping over a gap — 'Skipped rows' in the import report
tree-structure: the Function -> Process hierarchy. i-org-chart is the clean two-level tree; i-org is a cluster and i-network is a graph
warning-circle: the circled !; i-warning (triangle) is taken by ph-warning
